race_overlay.heat: September in Beykoz, Istanbul, Turkey can bring heat. Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before L'Etape Turkey by Tour de France. Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for L'Etape Turkey by Tour de France's 66 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. Use the organizer's current resupply plan for final carry decisions.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at L'Etape Turkey by Tour de France. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at L'Etape Turkey by Tour de France rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on paved climbs through touristic paradise to build confidence.
